design_detail: Prospective longitudinal study of people dependent on methamphetamine with repeated assessments; within-person comparison of psychotic symptoms during months of heavier vs. lighter vs. no use.
can_establish: That, within the same individuals, psychotic symptoms track periods of use in a dose-related way; this design removes stable between-person confounders.
cannot_establish: Effects in non-dependent or occasional users; the direction of short-term causation within a month (symptoms could precede escalation).

exposure.abstinence_at_testing: Varies by wave; that variation is the exposure.

comparison.unmeasured_premorbid: Controlled by design for stable traits; time-varying confounders (sleep loss, other drugs) partially adjusted.

replication.where_it_stands: Well supported; magnitude in non-dependent users less clear.

what_would_settle_it: Similar within-person designs in non-treatment samples; biological verification of use.

risk_of_bias.reasoning: Strong design for a causal question in observational data.
